subject: Your Reports Can Be Done in Seconds, Not Hours
body:
Hello,

I know we have been reaching out quite a bit, but I wanted to share something I think you would find really useful.

Automwrite's smart drag and drop import system can take any Fact Find, PDF image, unstructured meeting notes – even handwritten ones – and turn them into completely customisable, ready to use, suitability reports in seconds. Each and every report is unique to your client and their specific circumstances.

There are no rigid templates or fixed structures and we have the ability to make your reports look exactly the way you write them now.

If that sounds useful, I am happy to have a quick chat or send over more details. Alternatively, if you'd like me to stop reaching out, you can let me know too.

Warm regards,

metrics.notes: Emphasizes ease of implementation for cautious personas
